summary: Build custom decision environments from de-minimal with an ansible-builder version 3 file: base_image registry.redhat.io/ansible-automation-platform-26/de-minimal-rhel9:latest, galaxy collections (e.g. servicenow.itsm), optional python packages, python_interpreter package_system python3.12, exclude all_from_collections ansible.eda, and package_manager_path /usr/bin/microdnf.
questions: How do I build a custom decision environment with servicenow.itsm?
Why exclude ansible.eda in my decision environment definition?
Example ansible-builder file for a decision environment
How do I add Python packages to a decision environment?

answer_card.title: Custom decision environment definition
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
version: 3
images:
  base_image:
    name: 'registry.redhat.io/ansible-automation-platform-26/de-minimal-rhel9:latest'
dependencies:
  galaxy:
    collections:
      - name: servicenow.itsm
  python:          # optional extra packages
    - six
    - psutil
  python_interpreter:
    package_system: "python3.12"
  exclude:
    all_from_collections:
      - ansible.eda   # already in de-minimal
options:
  package_manager_path: /usr/bin/microdnf
```
